title: Who we are (Documentary)
quote: I remember the angelic choirs above that were fueling all this beautiful dancing and merriment served as yet another portal to higher and higher levels.

title: Renaissance (Documentary)
quote: The grass had a distinct loving music frequency coming from it.

experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
quote: This city that I was brought to had its own song. And it was full of love everywhere I looked. I would look to the left, to the right, up, down. There was no escape. I I literally felt like a soldier free falling into an ocean of blue liquid love that had no floor to it. And even there was the mountains and the trees and as the wind would blow, it would come alive and the leaves would swing back and forth and they would sing of the love. They would have a hymn of the light.

title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
quote: And we were all connected, and we were singing. I mean, it was music, but it makes music as we understand it pretty weak in comparison. This was living and breathing and color and dimension and all-encompassing. It was alive. The music was alive, and we were singing to one another.

experiencer: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
title: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
quote: Well, next thing, all of a sudden the sound begins to change. So we go from this kind of low drone sound to this more beautiful orchestral—I call it the Music of the Spheres—this symphony of sounds that don't sound like any kind of music that we have here. So I can't even really adequately describe it to you because I've never been able to hear it here or recreate it here.

title: The near death experience of Deborah King
quote: I also felt and heard these harmonic vibrations. I would say it was like a most beautiful choir I certainly had ever heard. But not human voices. Just incredibly beautiful harmonic sounds, and also dissonant sounds. But somehow they all worked together in an amazing, purposeful and beautiful way.
